Strong experience within home appliances, consumer electronics, consumer durables or premium consumer products . Proven experience managing a country business or major commercial operation. Extensive experience managing distributors, modern trade, key accounts, retail and e-commerce channels. Proven ability to negotiate strategic commercial partnerships and drive business development. Experience launching international brands or introducing new product categories into the Egyptian market is highly desirable. Strong leadership, negotiation, analytical and decision-making capabilities. Hands-on, entrepreneurial and commercially aggressive, with the ability to operate strategically while remaining close to day-to-day execution. Key Success Factors: The successful candidate will be expected to: Establish and successfully launch the business in Egypt. Build a sustainable commercial and distribution network. Deliver agreed revenue, gross margin and profitability targets. Develop strong relationships with major retailers and strategic partners. Build a capable local team and operating structure. Establish the business as a leading player in its target product categories.

review_candidates.title: Deputy Director
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mire Corporate Solutions is a growing professional services organization dedicated to supporting businesses with tailored corporate and operational solutions. The company focuses on improving organizational performance through strategic planning, process optimization, and efficient resource management. By partnering closely with clients, Mire Corporate Solutions aims to provide practical, results-oriented support that helps organizations achieve sustainable growth. Team members are encouraged to bring fresh ideas, collaborate across functions, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement. Role Description The Deputy Director is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, responsible for supporting the overall leadership, strategy, and operations of Mire Corporate Solutions. The role involves assisting in strategic planning, overseeing key projects and service delivery, and ensuring that organizational goals and performance targets are met. Day-to-day tasks include coordinating cross-functional teams, monitoring budgets and resources, preparing reports and presentations for senior leadership, and supporting client relationship management. The Deputy Director will contribute to policy development, risk management, and process improvement initiatives, while mentoring staff and helping maintain a collaborative and inclusive work environment. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong leadership and team management skills, including the ability to guide, motivate, and develop staff. Candidates should possess strategic planning and organizational development skills to support long-term business growth. Candidates should possess excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills to work effectively with clients and internal teams. Candidates should possess solid analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with data-driven decision-making and performance monitoring. Candidates should possess project and operations management skills, including planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and process improvement. Candidates should ideally have experience in corporate services, consulting, or a related professional services environment. Candidates should have a bachelor’s degree in business administration, management, economics, or a related field; a master’s degree is an advantage. Candidates should demonstrate high ethical standards, adaptability, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, multicultural setting.
